history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity CSV Load details.

events.description: Opens the CSV Load pop up screen for the selected PR
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near the desired PR Number and clicks Empty Container Load >> CSV Load

events.description: Opens the file browser. The selected file is uploaded, its upload status is shown, and its containers are listed in the grid
events.triggered_when: User clicks Select files... and chooses a CSV file
User clicks × next to the uploaded file name

events.description: Loads the containers from the uploaded file to the PR. A success or error message is shown
events.triggered_when: User clicks Load after uploading a file
events.remarks: "Containers from the selected file loaded successfully"

events.description: Clears the uploaded file and the container grid
Closes the CSV Load pop up
events.triggered_when: User clicks × on the pop up title bar
